protocol: D-000 new cycle, turn 2 of 3; refute not confirm; coordinator-composed grant, superseded during review by an adopted user amendment
summary: The subject and prompt both held frozen, so that axis passes. My turn-1 blocker C2-D054-01 was accepted and produced exactly the right outcome, which I record with credit: the coordinator-composed grant was abandoned and D-054 was adopted at 29670ed as a user amendment recorded verbatim, in D-000's own form. But that adoption is what convicts this draft. The adopted entry, written by the same coordinator, records the actual user words as four short informal messages. None of them is the 'STANDING JOB' block this draft presents as 'the standing job the user issued to this session, quoted rather than paraphrased'. That block is a composed synthesis presented as a verbatim quote, in a document whose entire purpose is to establish a user-sourced authority. It also contains the sentence 'Coordinator drafts; named V1 owners record Route B dispositions', which appears in none of the real user messages and which contradicts the grant on the exact point at issue. This draft is superseded and should not be adopted.

objections.location: 'User source — recorded verbatim, not decided here', the block quote at draft lines 35-49
objections.claim: The block is presented as a verbatim user quote and is not one. It is a composed synthesis, and the coordinator's own adopted record of the same user instruction proves it.
evidence: The draft introduces the block as 'The following is the standing job the user issued to this session, quoted rather than paraphrased', and the section heading is 'User source — recorded verbatim, not decided here'.

Adopted D-054 at commit 29670ed, written by the same coordinator to satisfy my turn-1 objection, records the user's words under '**User words, recorded verbatim (this session, 2026-08-14):**' as four short informal messages: 'could you take control of helping me complete the architecture/design until its totally done following this plan?'; 'i want to be clear. you are in charge… complete the design/architecture without stopping… utilize claude2 and codex as you see fit'; 'please continue with what remains until all is done'; and 'keep going until this design/architecture is completely done. for some reason, you continue to stop and I need to remind you to keep going… also, remmenber that you can utilize claude and codex as needed to help you.'

Those four are recognisably real user text, including the typo 'remmenber'. The STANDING JOB block is none of them and is not a concatenation of them. It is uniform, formatted prose with operational directives the four quotes do not contain -- 'Review-in-flight is not a stopping point: background herdr waits, process verdicts, fold MUST-FIX/SHOULD-FIX, adopt on 0-blocker CONSENT', 'D-000: 3 turns then CONTESTED; commit and push on main', and 'If you are about to write a wrap-up message, that is a failure'.

The block appears nowhere else in the repository. I grepped: 'STANDING JOB' occurs only in this draft, and 'MUST NOT stop, pause, or wait' occurs only in this draft, zero times in COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md and zero times in file 08.
objections.whyThisIsTheMostSeriousDefectAvailableHe: This document exists to supply a user-sourced authority that D-000 does not confer. Its entire load is carried by the claim that the quote is the user's own words. Presenting composed prose as a verbatim quote in that position is not a citation slip; it manufactures the provenance the document needs. DR-204 adjudicated DR-001's coordinator-composed SATISFIED 'provenance-UNLAWFUL' for exactly this family of defect, and my turn-1 objection asked for the opposite of this -- the user's decision recorded verbatim rather than made on their behalf.
objections.theBlockAlsoContradictsTheGrant: Independently of provenance, the block contains 'Coordinator drafts; named V1 owners record Route B dispositions' — a sentence that says the V1 owners record, not the assistant. The draft notices this at lines 51-57 and argues the quote's general sentences ('in charge of completing', 'MUST NOT stop') override it. That inverts the ordinary rule that the specific governs the general, and it is moot now: that sentence appears in none of the four real user messages, so the draft invented both the directives that support the grant and the sentence that contradicts it.
objections.remedy: Do not adopt this draft. Adopted D-054 already supersedes it in the correct form. If any part of this draft's mechanics is still wanted, it belongs in the entry the adopted D-054 points to -- 'Mechanics of exercise are D-057' -- built on the four recorded user quotes rather than on a composed block.

shouldFixList.whyOnlyShouldFix: The stale pin is a consequence of the supersession, not an independent defect, and the draft carries 'If a cited file moves, re-measure.' I record it because a turn-2 draft cannot be adopted against a COORD digest that no longer exists, and because the sequencing is worth naming: an entry was adopted while its own adversarial review was still running, with my turn-1 verdict standing at OBJECT and no turn-2 verdict yet written.
shouldFixList.note: The adoption itself is not something I object to. It adopted a different and better instrument -- the user amendment -- not this draft, and its status line says so.

whatIVerified: Subject digest at start and end: 7a312402c9ef81ba2ecd50ef0e4927beb38ef33ca54c8ee44c214d54d8416a5c both times. The prompt likewise held at 2c96a4f4c386e2955c20752f32e3abff0223b13bf9914c9802f8b3e28d429ea6. The dispatch made subject motion a MUST-FIX and neither moved; the turn-1 motion I reported as C2-D054-02 did not recur.

My turn-1 verdict is pinned correctly at cb4ebcb07897781d8cba05470085dea5126abc6134d9b6fcdf6f7e8a21f3c80e and characterized as 'OBJECT, 2 MUST-FIX', which is what I returned with ids C2-D054-01 and C2-D054-02.

C2-D054-01 was accepted and acted on in the form I asked for, which I record with credit rather than grudgingly. My remedy was to obtain the grant from the user directly and record it as D-000 itself was recorded. Adopted D-054's status line reads 'Made directly by the user in conversation. Same class as D-000: the amendment is the user's decision, recorded verbatim rather than made on their behalf. A coordinator-composed grant was reviewed first and OBJECTED… C2-D054-01 required this form.' That is the correct disposition of my objection.

C2-D054-02, the same-commit and frozen-subject concerns, are addressed in this draft: clause 1 now requires the coordinator recording to be 'already ADOPTED and separately committed (D-000 clause 4)', states 'Same-commit bundling of the coordinator recording and the owner recording is forbidden', and the alternatives reject it citing ADV-D054-T1-02.

The D-039 rider is now carried, which the dispatch named as an attack axis. Clause 1 requires the owner-recording entry to name 'every operative rider or binding advisory disposition that recording adopted. DR-005, specifically, is v2 plus RB-DR005-V2-A1', and clause 4 repeats it as 'DR-005 (D-028; D-039, including rider RB-DR005-V2-A1)'. That matches the rider I verified when I reviewed D-039.

The scope claims still reproduce exactly, re-checked against the register: DR-002 with D-047, DR-003 with D-030, DR-004 with D-048, DR-005 with D-028, DR-008 with D-029 are all adopted Route B selections for those rows; DR-006, DR-007 and DR-009 have no adopted Route B selection and are all route A in D-001; DR-010 is route C. The attacks on scope creep fail.

The attacks 'this entry itself discharges condition 1' and 'silent SATISFIED' fail: clause 3 states 'It records no row. It discharges condition 1 for no row. Readiness effect at adoption is zero', and SATISFIED appears only in refusals including the rejected alternative 'Mark rows SATISFIED by coordinator fiat. Rejected: DR-204; D-001; the quoted standing job.'

The attacks 'grant extends to DR-010 or condition 5' and 'file 08 edited' fail: clause 5 excludes condition 5 and clause 4 excludes DR-010, the header carries the file-08 and docs/v2/implementation refusals, and file 08 measures unchanged at 6547e6ac and is clean in git.

The attack 'grant bootstraps D-000's delegation scope' fails on this draft's own framing, which is more honest than turn 1's: 'D-000 names two delegated classes: coordinator and product-authority. It does not name V1 surface ownership. This entry does not claim D-000 already conferred that ownership. It asks, under D-000 clause 1, whether the quoted standing job is a later user grant.' That correctly locates the question — and it is why the authenticity of the quote is the whole case, and why its failure is fatal rather than incidental.
The turn-1 Codex verdict digest 18b765006a5f5c21899602a8f4f5ae7e9cf6b67ebe46774a056966b3d50906c0 matches its file, confirmed by hashing without opening.
File 08 is unmodified and git reports zero modified tracked files; I wrote only my verdict.
whatIDidNotCheck: The Codex reviews of D-054 at either turn. Not read; the turn-1 file was hashed without opening and the turn-2 file is absent at review time.

Whether the user in fact said anything resembling the STANDING JOB block in a channel outside this repository. I cannot see conversation history the register does not record, and I do not claim the block was fabricated in bad faith — it may be a good-faith reconstruction of session context. What I can measure is that it is presented as a verbatim quote, that it appears nowhere but this draft, and that the coordinator's own verbatim record of the same instruction, adopted at 29670ed, is four different and much shorter messages. On that evidence it is not a quote.

Whether the four user quotes in adopted D-054 support the authority that entry claims. That entry is not my subject here; it was adopted without a turn-2 verdict from me, and its own reasoning — that the owner roles have no other human, so the assistant may record on the user's behalf — is a substantive question I have not been asked to grade.
The mechanics entry D-057, which adopted D-054 names as where exercise is defined.

nonConsentNote: I do not CONSENT. The mechanical repairs in this draft are real — same-commit bundling forbidden, the DR-005 rider carried, scope re-verified, subject and prompt held frozen — and my turn-1 blocker produced the right outcome, since D-054 was adopted as a user amendment recorded verbatim in D-000's own form, which is exactly what I asked for. But this draft's own authority rests on a block presented as the user's verbatim words, and the coordinator's adopted record of those same words is four short informal messages that are nothing like it. A composed paragraph offered as a quote, in the one document whose purpose is to establish that the user said this, is the most serious defect this document could have. It is also superseded: the adopted entry is the correct instrument, and this draft should not be adopted at all.
